paragraphs.text: Elminster Aumar is a white/blue -aligned human wizard from the Forgotten Realms , featured in Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate . Though depicted on a planeswalker card, Elminster is not a planeswalker within Magic lore.

Also known as the "Sage of Shadowdale" and the "Old Mage", Elminster is one of the most famous and powerful wizards in all of Faerûn, as well as a fair fighter and thief. His magical prowess is sufficient to travel the planes of the Dungeons & Dragons multiverse relatively freely, having several crossovers with Mordenkainen despite their differing homeplanes.
Unlike planeswalkers in Magic lore, as a D&D character, he does not have a planeswalker's spark .
